# IANA example domains: public source card

Source classification: real-public-curated.
Original source: https://www.iana.org/help/example-domains
This card summarizes a live public IANA page; it is not the full original page.

IANA original excerpt:
A number of domains such as  example.com  and  example.org  are maintained for documentation purposes.

Reviewed paraphrase: example.com and example.org are reserved for illustrative documentation. Authors may use these names without arranging permission in advance. These names cannot be registered or transferred.

This card does not cover HTTP service reliability; consult the original IANA page for that separate topic.
